reports.title: Índice de Preços no Consumidor Nacional (IPCN)
reports.description: Angola's national CPI, published monthly by INE in both "Boletim" and "FIR" formats (most recent confirmed this round: July 2026 FIR, 9.33% YoY). INE's own "Notas Metodológicas do IPCN" (2025) explicitly names the classification standard: "Classificação do Consumo Individual por Objectivo (CCIO) ou COICOP." Base year December 2020 (rebased from a 2018-19 household survey). The series began in 1991 as Luanda-only and became fully national (covering all provinces) in January 2015.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly; both a full Boletim and a shorter FIR (Ficha de Informação Rápida) format confirmed current through July 2026.

reports.title: Relatório de Actividades do Sistema Estatístico Nacional de Angola 2018
reports.description: INE Angola's own annual activity report for the National Statistical System. Page 22 states verbatim: "Cumprimento a 100%. Informação é enviada para a SADC, que compila e publica o IPC Harmonizado da SADC" [100% compliance. Information is sent to SADC, which compiles and publishes the SADC Harmonised CPI]. This exact statement is also confirmed present in a 2013 edition of the same report series, indicating it is a standing, repeated practice rather than a one-off note. No CEEAC/ECCAS statistical citation was found this round.
reports.cadence_note: Annual activity report; the specific SADC-transmission statement confirmed present in both the 2018 and 2013 editions.

reports.title: Lei n.º 15/16 — Lei da Administração Local do Estado
reports.description: Angola's Law on Local State Administration. Article 21 states that provincial budgeting "está sujeita às normas em vigor que disciplinam... o Orçamento Geral do Estado" [is subject to the rules in force governing... the General State Budget] — provincial budgets are legally subordinate to, not independent of, the national OGE. Provincial governors are presidentially appointed (Constitution Art. 119(k)/125(4)), confirmed via decree citations for governor appointments as recent as 2025; Angola has never held local/autárquicas elections (a 2020 presidential quote — "Não se adiam eleições que nunca foram convocadas" [elections that were never called cannot be postponed] — and 2025-era news both confirm this remains the case). This corrects an earlier assumption in this branch's own research brief that Angola held provincial elections in 2025.

reports.title: Lei n.º 14/24 e Decreto Presidencial n.º 268/24 — Nova Divisão Político-Administrativa
reports.publisher: Assembleia Nacional / Presidência da República, Angola
reports.description: Law of 5 September 2024 and its implementing presidential decree, restructuring Angola from 18 to 21 provinces effective 1 January 2025 (three new provinces: Cuando, Icolo e Bengo, Moxico Leste). Governors of the new provinces were also presidentially appointed, not elected, consistent with ao-lei-administracao-local-15-16.
